PurchaseOrder.name: PurchaseOrder
PurchaseOrder.description: Represents the Purchase Order entity that captures a formal request from a Buyer to a Supplier to supply goods or services. It is identified by a unique PurchaseOrderNumber and tracks the order's lifecycle via a StatusCode. It defines commercial terms like the TotalAmount, BillingAccount, and the governing PriceBook. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

PurchaseOrderNumber.description: A unique identifier for the purchase order.

PurchaseOrderDate.description: The date and time when the purchase order was created.

PurchaseOrderType.description: The type of the purchase order such as standard, blanket, and contract.

BuyerAccount.description: The buyer account that initiated the purchase order.

SupplierAccount.description: The supplier account that received the purchase order.

BuyerContact.description: The primary contact person associated with the buyer account.

SupplierContact.description: The primary contact person associated with the supplier account.

StatusCode.description: The current status of the product in the purchase order.

BillingAccount.description: The account to which invoices are issued for the purchase order.

BillToContact.description: The contact associated with the billing account.

PriceBook.description: The price book that specifies the item prices applicable to the purchase order.

AdditionalInfo.description: Additional notes or remarks related to the purchase order.

TotalAmount.description: Sum of all total amounts from the PO Lines.

ExternalPurchaseOrderNumber.description: The reference number associated with the purchase order.

UsageType.description: Specify the context in which the Purchase Order is created.

RequestedDeliveryDate.description: The requested delivery date for the product.

ShippingLocation.description: The location to which the product is to be shipped.

ShippingAddress.description: The address to which the product is to be shipped.

ShipToContact.description: The contact associated with the shipping location.

ShipToAccount.description: The account associated with the shipping location.
